title: Apple Health — 추세 점검
description: 핵심 건강 지표의 장기 추세와 기간 비교 (중요도순)

panels.title: 최근 30일 vs 직전 31–90일 vs 1년 전 같은 30일
panels.description: 대시보드 시간 범위와 무관하게 항상 오늘 기준으로 계산합니다. 개선/악화는 각 지표의 바람직한 방향 기준이며 ±3%(시각은 ±15분) 이내는 '유지'. '변화'는 좋고 나쁨을 판단하지 않는 지표. 의학적 판단이 아닌 추세 참고용입니다.

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time > now() - INTERVAL 400 DAY
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
),
per AS (
    SELECT night, night AS d, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS h, (toHour(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') + 360) % 1440 AS bed_m, toHour(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') AS wake_m
    FROM nights GROUP BY night HAVING h >= 2
),
daily AS (
    SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
           sumIf(value, type = 'active_energy') AS active, sumIf(value, type = 'exercise_time') AS ex,
           sumIf(value, type = 'stand_time') AS stand
    FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
    WHERE bucket_start > now() - INTERVAL 400 DAY
    GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}')
),
samp AS (
    SELECT type, toDate(start_time, '${tz}') AS d, value FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE start_time > now() - INTERVAL 400 DAY AND type IN ('body_fat_percentage', 'body_mass', 'heart_rate_variability', 'lean_body_mass', 'resting_heart_rate', 'vo2_max', 'walking_asymmetry', 'walking_heart_rate_average', 'walking_speed')
),
wk AS (SELECT toDate(start_time, '${tz}') AS d FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL WHERE start_time > now() - INTERVAL 400 DAY),
m AS (
    SELECT 1 AS ord, '수면 시간' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(h, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(h, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(h, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM per
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS ord, '6시간 미만으로 잔 밤' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(if(h < 6, 100, 0), 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(if(h < 6, 100, 0), 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(if(h < 6, 100, 0), 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 0) AS ya FROM per
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS ord, '잠든 시각' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(bed_m, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(bed_m, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(bed_m, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 0) AS ya FROM per
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4 AS ord, '취침 시각 들쭉날쭉 (표준편차)' AS name, round(toFloat64(if(countIf(1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30) < 3, nan, stddevPopIf(bed_m, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30))), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(if(countIf(1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31) < 3, nan, stddevPopIf(bed_m, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31))), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(if(countIf(1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366) < 3, nan, stddevPopIf(bed_m, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366))), 0) AS ya FROM per
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5 AS ord, '안정시 심박' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 6 AS ord, '심박 변이도 (HRV)' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 7 AS ord, 'VO₂ max' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'vo2_max' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'vo2_max' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'vo2_max' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 8 AS ord, '걷기 평균 심박' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'walking_heart_rate_average' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'walking_heart_rate_average' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'walking_heart_rate_average' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 9 AS ord, '운동 시간' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(ex, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(ex, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(ex, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM daily
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 10 AS ord, '운동 기록 횟수' AS name, round(toFloat64(countIf(1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(countIf(1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31) / 2), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(countIf(1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM wk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 11 AS ord, '활동 에너지' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(active, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(active, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(active, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 0) AS ya FROM daily
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 12 AS ord, '걸음 수' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(steps, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(steps, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(steps, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 0) AS ya FROM daily
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 13 AS ord, '스탠드 시간' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(stand, 1 AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 0) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(stand, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 0) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(stand, 1 AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 0) AS ya FROM daily
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 14 AS ord, '걷기 비대칭' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'walking_asymmetry' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'walking_asymmetry' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'walking_asymmetry' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 15 AS ord, '걷기 속도' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 3.6, type = 'walking_speed' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 2) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 3.6, type = 'walking_speed' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 2) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 3.6, type = 'walking_speed' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 2) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 16 AS ord, '체중' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'body_mass' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'body_mass' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'body_mass' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 17 AS ord, '제지방량' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'lean_body_mass' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'lean_body_mass' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value, type = 'lean_body_mass' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 18 AS ord, '체지방률' AS name, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND d >= toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 30)), 1) AS cur, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 90 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 31)), 1) AS prev, round(toFloat64(avgIf(value * 100, type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND d BETWEEN toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 395 AND toDate(now(), '${tz}') - 366)), 1) AS ya FROM samp
)

panels.title: 월평균 수면 시간
panels.description: 회색 선: 권장 최소 7시간. 2시간 이상 잔 밤만 포함

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
),
per AS (
    SELECT night, night AS d, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS h, (toHour(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') + 360) % 1440 AS bed_m, toHour(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') AS wake_m
    FROM nights GROUP BY night HAVING h >= 2
)
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(night), '${tz}') AS time, avg(h) AS `평균 수면 시간`
FROM per GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
),
per AS (
    SELECT night, night AS d, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS h, (toHour(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') + 360) % 1440 AS bed_m, toHour(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') AS wake_m
    FROM nights GROUP BY night HAVING h >= 2
)
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(night), '${tz}') AS time, countIf(h < 6) / count() * 100 AS `6시간 미만`
FROM per GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 평균 잠든 시각 (자정 기준 ± 시간)
panels.description: 0 = 자정, 1.5 = 01:30, -0.5 = 23:30. 회색 선: 01:00 (현재 기상 시각 기준 7시간 수면을 위한 취침 시각)

targets.rawSql:
WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime, '${tz}') - INTERVAL 6 HOUR AND end_time < $__toTime
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
),
per AS (
    SELECT night, night AS d, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS h, (toHour(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') + 360) % 1440 AS bed_m, toHour(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') AS wake_m
    FROM nights GROUP BY night HAVING h >= 2
)
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(night), '${tz}') AS time, (avg(bed_m) - 360) / 60 AS `잠든 시각`
FROM per GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT toDate(end_time + INTERVAL 6 HOUR, '${tz}') AS night, source_name, category,
           dateDiff('second', start_time, end_time) AS secs, start_time, end_time
    FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
    WHERE type = 'sleep_analysis' AND category != 'in_bed' AND end_time > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
best AS (
    SELECT night, argMax(source_name, asleep) AS src
    FROM (SELECT night, source_name, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') AS asleep
          FROM seg GROUP BY night, source_name)
    GROUP BY night
),
nights AS (
    SELECT seg.night AS night, seg.source_name AS source_name, seg.category AS category,
           seg.secs AS secs, seg.start_time AS start_time, seg.end_time AS end_time
    FROM seg INNER JOIN best ON seg.night = best.night AND seg.source_name = best.src
),
per AS (
    SELECT night, night AS d, sumIf(secs, category LIKE 'asleep%') / 3600 AS h, (toHour(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(minIf(start_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') + 360) % 1440 AS bed_m, toHour(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') * 60 + toMinute(maxIf(end_time, category LIKE 'asleep%'), '${tz}') AS wake_m
    FROM nights GROUP BY night HAVING h >= 2
)
SELECT toString(toStartOfWeek(night, 1)) AS `주 (월요일 시작)`, count() AS `기록된 밤`,
  round(avg(h), 1) AS `평균 수면(시간)`, countIf(h < 6) AS `6시간 미만(일)`,
  formatDateTime(toDateTime('2000-01-01 18:00:00') + toIntervalMinute(toUInt32(greatest(round(avg(bed_m)), 0))), '%H:%i') AS `평균 잠든 시각`, round(stddevPop(bed_m)) AS `취침 편차(±분)`,
  formatDateTime(toDateTime('2000-01-01 00:00:00') + toIntervalMinute(toUInt32(greatest(round(avg(wake_m)), 0))), '%H:%i') AS `평균 기상 시각`
FROM per GROUP BY toStartOfWeek(night, 1) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS `안정시 심박`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS `HRV`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'heart_rate_variability' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS `VO₂ max`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'vo2_max' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: 같은 걷기에 심박이 낮을수록 체력이 좋음

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) AS `걷기 평균 심박`

GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 운동 시간
panels.description: 회색 선: WHO 권장 주 150분 ≈ 하루 21분

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `운동 시간`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'exercise_time') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'exercise_time') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, count() AS `운동 횟수`
FROM ${db}.workouts FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__fromTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') TO toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__toTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH STEP INTERVAL 1 MONTH

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `활동 에너지`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'active_energy') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'active_energy') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d), '${tz}') AS time, avg(v) AS `걸음 수`
FROM (SELECT toDate(bucket_start, '${tz}') AS d, sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS steps,
             sumIf(value, type = 'step_count') AS v
      FROM ${db}.quantity_stats FINAL
      WHERE type IN ('step_count', 'step_count') AND $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
      GROUP BY d HAVING steps > 0 AND d < toDate(now(), '${tz}'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 걷기 비대칭
panels.description: iPhone 측정값. 휴대 방식(주머니/가방)이 바뀌어도 달라질 수 있음

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 100 AS `평균 비대칭`,
       countIf(value > 0.2) / count() * 100 AS `20% 초과 측정 비율`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_asymmetry' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 3.6 AS `걷기 속도`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_speed' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, avg(value) * 100 AS `보폭`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL WHERE type = 'walking_step_length' AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, transform(type, ['body_mass', 'lean_body_mass'], ['체중', '제지방량'], type) AS series,
       value FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('body_mass', 'lean_body_mass') AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

SELECT start_time AS time, value AS `체지방률` FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type = 'body_fat_percentage' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: 심박 알림 (월별 횟수)
panels.description: Apple Watch의 높은/낮은 심박·불규칙 리듬 알림 합계. 기록이 없다면 Watch 앱 › 심장에서 알림이 켜져 있는지 확인

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(start_time, '${tz}'), '${tz}') AS time, count() AS `심박 알림`
FROM ${db}.samples FINAL
WHERE type IN ('high_heart_rate_event', 'low_heart_rate_event', 'irregular_heart_rhythm_event')
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__fromTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') TO toDateTime(toStartOfMonth(toDate($__toTime, '${tz}')), '${tz}') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH STEP INTERVAL 1 MONTH
